name: DarkNotes
description: A polished, mobile-first dark mode notes application with search, sort, and local persistence.
prompt: Build me a polished mobile-first notes application. Users should be able to create notes with a title and body, edit notes, delete notes, search notes by title or content, and sort notes by newest or oldest. Show a useful empty state when there are no notes. Persist notes in localStorage. Use a dark modern interface designed for phone screens. Use only HTML, CSS, and plain JavaScript.
